note: Owner-reviewed pair-color material for Chiron, the Nodes, and Lilith. The generator must paraphrase it; this artifact is never direct display copy.

entries.chiron.aries: Right now it is in Aries, so the sore spot is about going first: hesitating at the starting line, over-planning the bold move, flinching before anyone has said no. Just remember that a rough start still counts as one.
entries.chiron.taurus: Right now it is in Taurus, so the tenderness gathers around security: checking the balance twice, keeping two backup plans, needing the sure thing before the first step. Just notice when safety starts costing more than risk would.
entries.chiron.gemini: Right now it is in Gemini, so the sensitivity lives in the voice: rereading the text before sending, laughing off the question you meant seriously, letting the quick joke cover the real point. Just say one plain sentence a day and let it land.
entries.chiron.cancer: Right now it is in Cancer, so the soreness sits close to home: the family call that needs a warm-up lap, the holiday that arrives with homework, the comfort you give easily and rarely request. Just let someone return the care once.
entries.chiron.leo: Right now it is in Leo, so the tender spot is visibility: sharing the work but not the pride, deflecting the compliment mid-sentence, wanting the applause and dreading the attention. Just take the credit once without a disclaimer.
entries.chiron.virgo: Right now it is in Virgo, so the ache hides inside usefulness: fixing one more detail before resting, apologizing for errors nobody caught, keeping busy where feeling would be. Just let good enough finish something.
entries.chiron.libra: Right now it is in Libra, so the sensitivity runs through fairness: replaying the small conflict for days, agreeing early to keep the evening smooth, needing both sides happy before you can be. Just let one disagreement stand overnight.
entries.chiron.scorpio: Right now it is in Scorpio, so the sore spot guards the deep end: trusting slowly, testing before telling, holding the secret one season longer than it needs. Just hand one person the unedited version.
entries.chiron.sagittarius: Right now it is in Sagittarius, so the tenderness touches belief: defending the philosophy a little too hard, joking about the dream instead of naming it, keeping faith private so nobody can grade it. Just say what you actually believe to one person.
entries.chiron.capricorn: Right now it is in Capricorn, so the ache wears a work shirt: earning rest instead of taking it, treating help as a demotion, measuring the year by the title it produced. Just let one thing be enough this week.
entries.chiron.aquarius: Right now it is in Aquarius, so the sore spot is belonging: arriving late and leaving early, playing observer in your own circle, calling the distance independence. Just stay the extra half hour once and see what changes.
entries.chiron.pisces: Right now it is in Pisces, so the tenderness blurs at the edges: absorbing moods that are not yours, apologizing for tears before they finish, drifting off when the conversation gets close. Just name what belongs to you and hand the rest back.
entries.north-node.aries: Right now it is in Aries, so the growth points toward going first: the decision made without a poll, the solo trip, the sentence that starts with I want. Expect the first attempts to feel exposed; that is the direction working.
entries.north-node.taurus: Right now it is in Taurus, so the growth points toward the solid and slow: money saved on purpose, food that took an hour, one commitment kept until it bears weight. The unglamorous choice is the forward one this season.
entries.north-node.gemini: Right now it is in Gemini, so the growth points toward the near and specific: the beginner question, the sibling answered, the small fact checked before the big theory. Curiosity beats certainty while it is here.
entries.north-node.cancer: Right now it is in Cancer, so the growth points home: the feeling named at the table, the household tended on purpose, the care accepted without a repayment plan. Softness is the skill being built.
entries.north-node.leo: Right now it is in Leo, so the growth points toward the open stage: the work signed, the delight shown in public, the yes to being seen enjoying it. Wanting attention is not the flaw this season; hiding is.
entries.north-node.virgo: Right now it is in Virgo, so the growth points toward the useful and exact: the routine kept, the checkup booked, the craft practiced until it holds. Small maintenance is the forward motion.
entries.north-node.libra: Right now it is in Libra, so the growth points toward the duet: the explicit agreement, the compromise that costs something, the plan made in pairs. Letting another person weigh in is the practice.
entries.north-node.scorpio: Right now it is in Scorpio, so the growth points into the deep water: the honest conversation under the pleasant one, the merged resource, the trust extended past comfortable. Surface answers stop counting for a while.
entries.north-node.sagittarius: Right now it is in Sagittarius, so the growth points at the horizon: the course enrolled, the journey booked, the conviction said without a footnote. The bigger frame is the assignment.
entries.north-node.capricorn: Right now it is in Capricorn, so the growth points up the mountain: the responsibility accepted, the long plan started, the standard raised because your name is on it. Structure is the new frontier.
entries.north-node.aquarius: Right now it is in Aquarius, so the growth points toward the group: the community joined, the cause given real hours, the future planned with more names than yours. Belonging is the skill under construction.
entries.north-node.pisces: Right now it is in Pisces, so the growth points inward and outward at once: the rest taken seriously, the compassion given without keeping count, the imagination trusted one size larger. Softening is progress here.
entries.south-node.aries: Right now it is in Aries, so the familiar move is going it alone: deciding first and informing later, the solo push, the reflex no to help. The skill is real; the autopilot is the tell.
entries.south-node.taurus: Right now it is in Taurus, so the familiar move is staying put: the proven routine, the known income, the comfort defended past its usefulness. Notice when settled quietly becomes stuck.
entries.south-node.gemini: Right now it is in Gemini, so the familiar move is talking through it: the extra tab, the clever reply, the conversation that circles instead of lands. Fluency is the comfort zone this season.
entries.south-node.cancer: Right now it is in Cancer, so the familiar move is retreating to the nest: the family role resumed without asking, the feelings managed for everyone, home as headquarters and hideout. Tend it without moving back in.
entries.south-node.leo: Right now it is in Leo, so the familiar move is winning the crowd: the proven charm, the reliable bit, the spotlight found by instinct. Applause is the old currency; check what it still buys.
entries.south-node.virgo: Right now it is in Virgo, so the familiar move is perfecting the details: the list rewritten, the plan tuned again, the usefulness offered before anyone asks. Competence is the comfort food.
entries.south-node.libra: Right now it is in Libra, so the familiar move is smoothing it over: the early agreement, the softened opinion, the peace kept at personal cost. Harmony is the practiced skill and the old hiding place.
entries.south-node.scorpio: Right now it is in Scorpio, so the familiar move is going deep by default: the crisis handled brilliantly, the secret kept expertly, the intensity trusted more than the calm. Notice when depth becomes the only setting.
entries.south-node.sagittarius: Right now it is in Sagittarius, so the familiar move is the exit toward meaning: the next book, another trip, the big idea that relocates the question. The horizon is the comfort zone.
entries.south-node.capricorn: Right now it is in Capricorn, so the familiar move is climbing: the title accepted by reflex, the duty absorbed without a vote, the worth measured in output. The ladder is well practiced; check where it leans.
entries.south-node.aquarius: Right now it is in Aquarius, so the familiar move is the observer's seat: the group joined at the edges, the opinion held back for the collective mood, the cool read instead of the warm one. Distance is the old expertise.
entries.south-node.pisces: Right now it is in Pisces, so the familiar move is dissolving: the plan left vague, the conflict slept off, the drift that passes for peace. Rest is real; vanishing is the habit to watch.
entries.lilith.aries: Right now she is in Aries, so the unfiltered part wants to go first: the blunt open, the fight picked cleanly, the desire named before it is polite. Watch the difference between directness and detonation.
entries.lilith.taurus: Right now she is in Taurus, so the unfiltered part is appetite: the expensive taste admitted, the comfort claimed without apology, the no that does not move. Just aim the stubbornness at something worth keeping.
entries.lilith.gemini: Right now she is in Gemini, so the unfiltered part is the unsaid sentence: the opinion left in drafts, the question everyone skips, the truth that arrives as a joke. The direct version costs less than the swallowed one.
entries.lilith.cancer: Right now she is in Cancer, so the unfiltered part lives at home: the family topic nobody opens, the no said to a relative, the need voiced instead of cooked into dinner. A household can survive one honest evening.
entries.lilith.leo: Right now she is in Leo, so the unfiltered part wants the stage back: the loud outfit, the unapologetic post, the pride worn without a permission slip. Shine for your own reasons and it holds.
entries.lilith.virgo: Right now she is in Virgo, so the unfiltered part is the refusal inside the helpfulness: the task declined, the standard defended, the invisible labor finally named. Precision includes saying no precisely.
entries.lilith.libra: Right now she is in Libra, so the unfiltered part is the preference: the restaurant actually chosen, the disagreement voiced at speaking volume, the fifty-fifty renegotiated. Fairness includes you.
entries.lilith.scorpio: Right now she is in Scorpio, so the unfiltered part is the taboo drawer: the desire admitted, the grief aired, the power taken back from the old arrangement. Said plainly, it loses its charge.
entries.lilith.sagittarius: Right now she is in Sagittarius, so the unfiltered part is the heresy: the doubt spoken in the pew, the tradition declined, the belief built from experience instead of inheritance. Question loudly and kindly.
entries.lilith.capricorn: Right now she is in Capricorn, so the unfiltered part is ambition without the costume: the title asked for, the credit corrected, the rule broken because it never made sense. Respectability was always optional.
entries.lilith.aquarius: Right now she is in Aquarius, so the unfiltered part is the dissent: the opinion that breaks the group mood, the cause questioned from inside, the membership tested with honesty. Real circles bend without breaking.
entries.lilith.pisces: Right now she is in Pisces, so the unfiltered part surfaces in dreams and slips: the recurring dream with a message, the tears that arrive sideways, the longing dismissed as impractical. What leaks out sideways is the material to name.
